messages.content: What is the time now in New York City?

function.name: calculate_sunrise_and_sunset
function.description: Calculate the sunrise and sunset time of a location for the given date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location in city, state format.

date.description: The date for which the sunrise and sunset needs to be calculated in yyyy-mm-dd format.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time clocks or the current system time. To find the exact time in New York City right now, you can check a reliable world‑clock website, your phone’s clock, or a smart‑assistant device set to the Eastern Time Zone.
message.reasoning: We need to answer current time in NYC. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate using UTC offset. But we need to be careful: It's currently 2026-10-19. In October, New York is on Eastern Daylight Time (EDT) until first Sunday in November. So UTC-4. So if current UTC time is known? We don't have. We could say "I don't have real-time data." But maybe we can use the system's time? The assistant likely doesn't have real-time. We can respond that we can't provide real-time. Or we can approximate by using the current time from the environment? But we don't have that. So best to say we don't have real-time.
